QUOTE: `#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member` ... "Default (opt-out not set): `ctx.MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(nr)` becomes `ctx.private_nr`" ... "With the opt-out: the same token becomes `ctx.nr`, the real field name."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both the default rename to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS yields the unchanged member name.
